in_sanskrit.name: हेमल
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Hemal is derived from the Sanskrit word 'hem' which means 'gold' or 'wealth'. It is not a standard name in any of the major Indian languages and cultures, but the meaning and origin of the name are rooted in Sanskrit and Indian mythology.

in_hindi.name: Hemal
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Sun
in_hindi.long_meaning: Hemal एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। One whose face is golden like the setting sun

in_tamil.name: Hemal
in_tamil.long_meaning: Hemal ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। One whose face is golden like the setting sun

in_telugu.name: Hemal
in_telugu.long_meaning: Hemal ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। One whose face is golden like the setting sun

in_marathi.name: Hemal
in_marathi.long_meaning: Hemal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One whose face is golden like the setting sun

in_bengali.name: Hemal
in_bengali.long_meaning: Hemal একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One whose face is golden like the setting sun
